The '''''Fallon''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] during his hunt of the squad hired by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Purton]] to kill him in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].
